features_14_ladder_emotion_critique.bug1_gap_ratio_fix: Fixed division by zero/negative denominator when max_height <= 2. Explicit definition: If max_height <= 2, gap_ratio = 0.0; otherwise sum(I(n_k == 0, k=2..H-1)) / (H - 2).
features_14_ladder_emotion_critique.bug2_empty_cohort_nan_fix: Empty tier cohorts (e.g. n_3_prev == 0) must strictly yield NaN, NEVER 0.0. Tree models handle NaN natively without falsely equating absence of stocks with 100% crash.
features_14_ladder_emotion_critique.bug3_big_loss_ratio_definition: Strictly defined as percentage of yesterday's relay stocks closing <= -5.0% today, with NaN for empty relay cohorts.
features_14_ladder_emotion_critique.delta3_momentum_path: 3-day momentum difference between day S and day S-3, capturing the first derivative of emotion warming, diverging, or receding.

features_5_sealing_quality_analysis.difference_from_failed_old64_66: Old 64 and 66 treated seal minute/amount as pro-cyclical unconditional linear factors, causing severe bull traps during receding waves. Under ladder structure and emotion trajectory, sealing quality acts as a conditional interaction factor.

core_rationales: Directly addresses user directive: '最重要的是要精准判断情绪'. Without an explicit head, emotion is mere passive tabular noise in a greedy tree.
Solves cross-sectional sample domination (N=42 vs T=668), forcing regularized macro emotion prior into a 1D calibrated scalar.
Provides independent MAE/RMSE evaluation of emotion prediction accuracy against realized cohort promotion rates.

arm_A.name: LADDER_SEAL_DIRECT_81
arm_A.architecture: Single-stage flat GBDT predicting next-day limit Top-1 directly

arm_B.name: LADDER_EMOTION_HIERARCHICAL_82
arm_B.architecture: Two-stage hierarchical: Stage 1 Rolling 252-day Ridge(alpha=1.0) OOF predicting next-day first-board pool promotion rate E_hat; Stage 2 GBDT conditioned on E_hat
arm_B.independent_metric: Emotion Head MAE and RMSE against realized first-board promotion rate
